summary: --max-suffix-files caps total replay width instead of suffix length, silently refusing valid candidates in wider gates.
Timed-out or aborted replay attempts are omitted from suffix_replays and replays_used, making audit output false.
Replay setup or launch OSError bypasses the typed suffix skip and can crash compare without its required JSON verdict.
The real-body test cannot detect execution of the contaminator test, so it does not prove deselection as claimed.
No test exercises the new non-JSON SUFFIX-ATTRIBUTED rendering.
No test exercises and asserts the new suffix_dropped_files audit branch.
